item.name: Wind
item.cardSummary: The cheapest weather and the pure grind pick: faster casts for everyone on the server while it lasts.

item.name: Snow
item.effect: Chance for caught fish to gain the Frozen mutation
item.cardSummary: Coats catches with a shot at the Frozen mutation, a cheap way to add mutation value to a farming session.

item.name: Cloudy
item.effect: Boosts luck, especially for rare fish
item.cardSummary: The straightforward luck buy: better odds at rare catches for the whole server.

item.name: Storm
item.effect: Combines Wind and Cloudy: faster rods plus luck
item.cardSummary: The efficiency pick, bundling the speed and luck weathers into one activation.

item.name: Radiant
item.effect: Raises the chance of shiny variant fish
item.cardSummary: The shiny hunter's weather, tilting catches toward the rarer, more valuable shiny variants.

item.name: Shark Hunt
item.effect: Triggers the Shark Hunt event with the Ghost Shark catchable
item.cardSummary: The premium event weather: while the hunt runs, the Ghost Shark swims in the affected waters.
